attack_plan.narrative: The situation in Moscow remains tense as reports continue to circulate about Vladimir Putin's whereabouts. Recent sightings of white smoke above the Kremlin have fueled speculation about potential changes within the highest levels of government. Meanwhile, a mysterious film showing Putin in Crimea has surfaced, with some questioning its authenticity. Critics point to the unexplained absences of key Kremlin personnel and the recent release of a photo featuring Putin alongside Kim Jong-un, described as 'doing well, somewhere in hell.' The Kremlin's actions, such as the release of the photo and the preparations for a military parade marking the one-year anniversary of Crimea's occupation, add to the intrigue. Observers are watching closely, as the world waits to see if Putin will make an appearance and clarify his status. The uncertainty surrounding Putin's health and the Kremlin's behavior suggests a possible internal power struggle or even a palace coup, given the heightened tensions both domestically and internationally.
